rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided Gardner 4AA label and notes hatching/herniation appropriately, but the image itself is limited and the response overstates confidence in clearly visualizing a compact ICM and uniformly grade A TE from this single focal plane.
Integrates age, ovarian reserve, endometrial thickness, prior cycle, male factor context, and embryo grade into prognosis well, though some links are somewhat speculative.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a plausible implantation estimate tied to embryo quality and patient factors; minor issues include unsupported numerical adjustments and overinterpretation of lifestyle effects.

Much of the assessment is broadly evidence-based, but recommendations such as routine low-dose aspirin, ERA after only one failed cycle, thrombophilia/MTHFR testing, immune/NK testing, and broad workup before recurrent failure are not strongly guideline-supported.

Provides clear practical steps for transfer technique, luteal support review, and contingency planning, though several suggested investigations/interventions are more aggressive than typically indicated for this case.
